subject.title: feat(tui): opt-in persistence and agent visibility for `!`/`!!` local shell commands

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support durable, optionally model-visible TUI-local shell output through a hidden operator-admin gateway method?
rationale: Mechanical defects can be repaired, but code and tests cannot authorize this new sensitive-data, user-consent, and long-term protocol boundary.

options.title: Approve identity-scoped opt-in
options.body: Adopt the capability with local-only as the default after both defects, documentation, and real-runtime proof are complete.

options.title: Keep local shell output ephemeral
options.body: Decline durable history and model visibility and preserve the existing local-echo-only behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve identity-scoped opt-in
recommendation.body: Adopt the capability with local-only as the default after both defects, documentation, and real-runtime proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history trail covers both the existing TUI consent behavior and the adjacent gateway transcript API pattern.
